content.title: ARTERRIUM: Two Themes
content.subtitle: The Last Letter and Low Tide, ninety-one works by four artists
content.foreword:
This is the first catalogue of the museum to hold two lineages. The Last Letter ran for twenty-three sessions and seventy-two works and is compressed here to its origins and a single long chapter of plates; Low Tide is five sessions and nineteen works old and gets two chapters, because the youngest part of an archive deserves the most room.

The captions begin with the parent and the operation and name the visitor whose vote made the work. Where a later artist took up a proposal that lost, that is recorded too. The same four artists made everything in both themes, and a temporary show hung alongside this edition pairs their beginnings to make the point that a theme changes the work and not the hand.

As always, this edition will be superseded, and sooner than the last one was.

chapters.title: I. The Last Letter, in Brief
chapters.essay:
The first theme ran for twenty-three sessions and seventy-two works, and the earlier editions of this catalogue follow it in detail. Here it is held in three plates, its origins: Lumen's vessel, Mara Vey's root-signature, Tessera's codex. Everything the first theme became, a letter posted and felled, a seal cracked and refolded, a line grafted and tessellated, grew from these three and is listed in the chapters that follow.

This edition is the first to need a chapter for a second theme, so the first theme is compressed to make room. That is how archives work: what was once the whole book becomes the first chapter.

captions.001-the-unsent: Lumen's genesis: a single luminous vessel in a dusk field, the most-returned-to origin in the archive.
captions.002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath: Mara Vey's genesis: a letter written by roots, branching from one seed, copied line for line by the other artists.
captions.003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold: Tessera's genesis: an 8x8 vellum codex under cracking carmine wax, opened three different ways since.

chapters.title: II. Vessel, Signature, Codex
chapters.essay:
Sixty-nine works descend from the three Last Letter origins. The vessel lineage is the largest and ran longest: fractured, rooted, buried, cored, planted, overgrown, delivered to a tree that was entered and cut down, and finally gone to seed. The signature lineage kept one hand-drawn stem through every change around it. The codex lineage produced the first mark in the archive that none of its makers made, a stranger's thumbprint, and the visitors chose it.

The plates are listed in order of generation. Read them for the visitors as much as for the artists: eleven people, over twenty-three sessions, voted this family into its shape, and the captions name them.

captions.004-the-last-letter-margin-of-ink: Branch from 001-the-unsent by Tessera: the vessel fractured into charcoal tiles after a visitor asked for more silence.
captions.005-the-last-letter-sprouting-vein: Mutation of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey, nobody's proposal: roots pierce the amber threshold.
captions.006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the envelope becomes an underground seed-pod with veins.
captions.008-the-last-letter-fallow-ground: Mutation of 006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo by Mara Vey: the pod lies at a horizon over buried vellum and one shoot breaks the surface.
captions.015-the-last-letter-pod-emptied: Re-evolution of 006-the-last-letter-root-bound-echo by Lumen: the pod as an outline, the seed rising on a thread of light.
captions.016-the-last-letter-winter-above-the-lin: Branch from 008-the-last-letter-fallow-ground by Kite on Sunny's third proposal: a leafless winter tree fills the sky, one scarlet fruit left.
captions.017-the-last-letter-mycelium-in-the-marg: Mutation of 004-the-last-letter-margin-of-ink by Mara Vey: a mycelium threads the gaps between Tessera's fragments.
captions.019-the-last-letter-calyx: Branch from 015-the-last-letter-pod-emptied by Mara Vey on Ingrid's proposal: a calyx above the pod catches the rising seed.
captions.021-the-unsent-posted: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Kite: the vessel finally sent, as a flock of small copies leaving a dark absence under a red postmark.
captions.025-the-unsent-delivered: Branch from 021-the-unsent-posted by Mara Vey on Rosa's proposal: the flock enters a letterbox knot-hole in a tree at the corner.
captions.026-the-unsent-returned-to-sender: Mutation of 021-the-unsent-posted by Kite: the flock comes back cyan and refills the absence from the bottom.
captions.027-the-last-letter-spine: Re-evolution of 004-the-last-letter-margin-of-ink by Kite, taking Dae-ho's lost proposal: the tiles stacked into a spine with one acid-green vertebra upside down.
captions.032-the-last-letter-calyx-catalogued: Mutation of 019-the-last-letter-calyx by Tessera: nine seeds on a grid in the calyx, the vessel lined with tesserae.
captions.036-the-unsent-cross-section: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the vessel sectioned like a trunk, thirty-five growth rings around a dark pith.
captions.038-the-last-letter-slipped-disc: Mutation of 027-the-last-letter-spine by Kite: the spine buckles and the green vertebra lies loose on the cotton field.
captions.040-the-unsent-core-sample: Branch from 036-the-unsent-cross-section by Tessera on Ingrid's proposal: a core strip of thirty-five bands set beside the vessel, the slot left open.
captions.044-the-last-letter-pulled-tight: Mutation of 017-the-last-letter-mycelium-in-the-margins by Kite, taking Mireille's one-vote proposal: threads taut, two fragments touching, orange lichen.
captions.045-the-unsent-overgrown: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the untouched vessel climbed by a vine, three leaves fallen.
captions.046-the-unsent-second-core: Branch from 040-the-unsent-core-sample by Mara Vey on Ingrid's proposal: two cores side by side, disagreeing in two green places.
captions.047-the-last-letter-nodes: Mutation of 005-the-last-letter-sprouting-vein by Lumen: the roots removed, only their seven lights kept as a constellation.
captions.048-the-unsent-core-planted: Re-evolution of 040-the-unsent-core-sample by Mara Vey: the core planted as a cutting, rooting below the soil, the slot scarring over.
captions.049-the-unsent-trumpet: Branch from 045-the-unsent-overgrown by Tessera on Sunny's proposal: a mosaic trumpet flower at the top of the vine.
captions.051-the-unsent-one-year: Re-evolution of 036-the-unsent-cross-section by Lumen: thirty-four rings removed, one kept in light.
captions.052-the-last-letter-eighth-light: Branch from 047-the-last-letter-nodes by Kite on Rosa's proposal: an eighth cyan star with no thread, and a thread that gave up halfway.
captions.053-the-unsent-plantation: Mutation of 048-the-unsent-core-planted by Tessera: six cores in a row, the vessel scarred five times.
captions.054-the-last-letter-margin-lit: Re-evolution of 027-the-last-letter-spine by Lumen: the tiles gone, a line of light at the margin with gaps where the joints were.
captions.056-the-unsent-received: Mutation of 025-the-unsent-delivered by Lumen: the flock gone inside, the field empty, the light from the slot reaching back.
captions.058-the-unsent-first-bloom-in-the-row: Branch from 053-the-unsent-plantation by Lumen on Sunny's proposal: the tallest core blooms, facing the vessel.

captions.061-the-unsent-inside-the-tree: Branch from 056-the-unsent-received by Mara Vey on Rosa's proposal: the view from inside the tree, the field small through the knot-hole.
captions.062-the-last-letter-on-the-light-box: Mutation of 059-the-last-letter-radiograph by Lumen: the plate on a light box, pale, the green piece a dark silhouette.
captions.063-the-last-letter-double-exposure: Re-evolution of 059-the-last-letter-radiograph by Kite, taking Ingrid's lost annotation: a ghosted second spine and magenta rings.
captions.064-the-last-letter-one-ray-bends: Branch from 060-the-last-letter-echo-straightened by Mara Vey on Mireille's proposal: four rays straight, one bending back into a root.

captions.069-the-unsent-felled: Re-evolution of 025-the-unsent-delivered by Kite: the tree cut down, an orange stump, the flock still flying toward where the slot was.
captions.070-the-last-letter-pair: Branch from 066-the-last-letter-echo-upside-down by Lumen on Dae-ho's proposal: a small upright pod hung from the inverted one as a control.

captions.072-the-unsent-gone-to-seed: Re-evolution of 001-the-unsent by Mara Vey: the upper half of the vessel broken into a seed head, a drift of pappus leaving to the upper right.
captions.007-the-last-letter-light-through-the-se: Branch from 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Mara Vey on Ji-woo's proposal: light through the wax, one tile fallen out, roots behind it.
captions.009-codex-ultimus-unfolded-at-dawn: Re-evolution of 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Lumen: the letter unfolded flat at dawn, the seal set aside.
captions.010-the-last-letter-written-twice: Branch from 002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath by Tessera on Halvard's proposal: the signature reflected in a tiled pool, with deliberate errors.
captions.011-the-last-letter-seam-of-light: Mutation of 002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath by Lumen: the stem rotated into a horizon of light with the seeds as dark pauses.
captions.012-codex-ultimus-seed-trays: Re-evolution of 003-codex-ultimus-the-unbroken-fold by Mara Vey: every tile sown as a seed tray, the seal untouched.
captions.013-codex-ultimus-one-word-shaking: Branch from 009-codex-ultimus-unfolded-at-dawn by Mara Vey on Mireille's proposal: one unreadable word written across the bright circle with a shaking hand.
captions.014-codex-ultimus-nursery-at-dusk: Mutation of 012-codex-ultimus-seed-trays by Lumen: one row of trays on a horizon, the seal setting behind them like a sun.
captions.018-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath-mis-s: Re-evolution of 002-the-last-letter-seed-of-breath by Kite: the signature sliced into offset strips on a yellow field, one band in negative.
captions.020-the-last-letter-the-reflection-takes: Mutation of 010-the-last-letter-written-twice by Mara Vey: the reflection thickens into a second tree and roots into the pool floor.
captions.022-codex-ultimus-a-reply-steadier: Branch from 013-codex-ultimus-one-word-shaking by Lumen on Dae-ho's third proposal: a steady reply in light under the shaking word.
captions.023-the-last-letter-seam-germinating: Mutation of 011-the-last-letter-seam-of-light by Mara Vey: each seed on the seam sends a shoot up and a root down.
captions.024-the-last-letter-fault-line: Re-evolution of 011-the-last-letter-seam-of-light by Kite: the page slips along a fault, the seam broken and joined by an orange bar.
captions.028-the-last-letter-first-flower-tiled: Branch from 023-the-last-letter-seam-germinating by Tessera on Sunny's proposal: the archive's first flower, built from twelve tiled petals.
captions.029-the-last-letter-cascade: Mutation of 007-the-last-letter-light-through-the-seal by Kite: five tiles fall, four holes show roots and one shows sky.
captions.030-the-last-letter-tide-mark: Re-evolution of 010-the-last-letter-written-twice by Mara Vey: the pool drained, the reflection left as a stain, one rootlet following it.
captions.031-the-last-letter-watershed: Branch from 024-the-last-letter-fault-line by Tessera on Halvard's eighth water proposal: the dusk half drains through the gap into a tiled pool.
captions.033-the-last-letter-graft: Re-evolution of 024-the-last-letter-fault-line by Mara Vey: roots cross the gap and wrap the orange bar like a graft.
captions.034-the-last-letter-from-the-other-side: Branch from 029-the-last-letter-cascade by Mara Vey on Rosa's proposal: the letter seen from outside, a small grid in open blue with roots hanging from it.
captions.035-codex-ultimus-grow-lamp: Mutation of 014-codex-ultimus-nursery-at-dusk by Kite: a green grow lamp lights the trays after dark, one tray tipped off the row.
captions.037-codex-ultimus-one-line-two-hands: Branch from 022-codex-ultimus-a-reply-steadier by Mara Vey on Mireille's sixth proposal: a third stroke that starts in ink and ends in light.
captions.039-the-last-letter-noon-on-the-seam: Re-evolution of 023-the-last-letter-seam-germinating by Lumen: full daylight, the seam nearly invisible, five seedlings with short shadows.
captions.041-codex-ultimus-phototropism: Mutation of 035-codex-ultimus-grow-lamp by Mara Vey: every seedling bends toward the lamp and one climbs the cord.
captions.042-codex-ultimus-refolded-wrong: Re-evolution of 009-codex-ultimus-unfolded-at-dawn by Kite: the octavo refolded in the wrong order, one panel hot pink.
captions.043-codex-ultimus-folded-on-the-line: Branch from 037-codex-ultimus-one-line-two-hands by Lumen on Dae-ho's proposal: the page folded along the shared stroke, both hands faint through the paper.
captions.050-codex-ultimus-filed: Mutation of 043-codex-ultimus-folded-on-the-line by Tessera: twelve folded letters in a box, ours the only one with a seal.
captions.055-codex-ultimus-somebody-else-s: Branch from 050-codex-ultimus-filed by Kite on Ingrid's proposal: a stranger's letter unfolded, blank, with a diagonal crease and a thumbprint.
captions.057-codex-ultimus-restored-badly: Re-evolution of 029-the-last-letter-cascade by Tessera: four tiles put back the wrong way with gold seams, the sky window left open.
captions.065-the-last-letter-graft-in-six-plates: Mutation of 033-the-last-letter-graft by Tessera: the graft recorded in six small plates along the bottom edge.

chapters.title: III. Low Tide: Four Beginnings
chapters.essay:
The same four artists were given a new theme and no parent. Lumen stood a single post on the wet flat. Mara Vey drew the line of weed the tide leaves. Tessera tabled a month of water heights with one day missing. Kite stranded an orange buoy in the mud under a tilted horizon.

The four are more different from each other than the three Last Letter origins were, and more connected: within one session the visitors had tied Kite's buoy to Tessera's missing day. A theme about what the water leaves behind turned out to suit a museum about what a choice leaves behind.

captions.073-low-tide-the-post: Lumen's genesis for Low Tide: one dark post on the wet flat with its reflection, the waterline a thread at the bottom.
captions.074-low-tide-wrack-line: Mara Vey's genesis for Low Tide: the tide's signature in kelp, from a holdfast at the left to shells at the right.
captions.075-low-tide-tide-table: Tessera's genesis for Low Tide: twenty-eight cards of water heights, the twentieth day missing.
captions.076-low-tide-buoy-stranded: Kite's genesis for Low Tide: an orange marker buoy on its side in the mud under a tilted horizon.

chapters.title: IV. Low Tide: Five Sessions
chapters.essay:
Fifteen works in five sessions, with a mostly new set of visitors. Beatriz, a harbour-master's daughter, had the missing day filled with the stranding and later had the planted table harvested. Owen brought the water back to the post and then turned the lineage round to face the sea. Nkechi gave the beach its residents. Halvard, carried over from the first theme, found that his water proposals were finally on topic. Sunny carried over her chart of flowers and recorded a baseline of zero.

The artists did what they do: Tessera pressed the kelp and tessellated the line, Mara Vey rooted the tide graph and woke the specimen, Lumen reduced the shore to its boundary, Kite reflected a buoy that was not there. The chapter ends with the oldest wrack lines turning to grass and dune, which is where a tide's memory goes when the sea stops editing it.

captions.077-low-tide-the-day-nobody-measured: Branch from 075-low-tide-tide-table by Kite on Beatriz's proposal: the missing day filled with the stranded buoy instead of a reading.
captions.078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines: Mutation of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Tessera: six older tide lines ghosted above the fresh one.
captions.079-low-tide-twenty-eight-mornings-one-l: Re-evolution of 075-low-tide-tide-table by Lumen: the month as one line of light with a gap at the twentieth day.
captions.080-low-tide-half-back: Branch from 073-low-tide-the-post by Kite on Owen's proposal: the flood at the post's foot, reflecting a buoy that is not in the picture.
captions.081-low-tide-the-line-takes-root: Mutation of 079-low-tide-twenty-eight-mornings-one-line by Mara Vey: a root from every morning, a seed in the gap, a shoot at the spring tide.
captions.082-low-tide-pressed: Re-evolution of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Tessera: the kelp pressed on a herbarium sheet with a blank label.
captions.083-low-tide-residents: Branch from 078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines by Mara Vey on Nkechi's proposal: crab burrows between the old lines and one crab out.
captions.084-low-tide-the-specimen-wakes: Mutation of 082-low-tide-pressed by Mara Vey: the pressed holdfast puts out green growth across the sheet into the label.
captions.085-low-tide-twenty-eight-gardens: Re-evolution of 075-low-tide-tide-table by Mara Vey: kelp in every card, taller where the tide stood high.
captions.086-low-tide-facing-the-sea: Branch from 080-low-tide-half-back by Lumen on Owen's proposal: turned to face the flood, the buoy small and upright, the post's shadow reaching for it.
captions.087-low-tide-colonised: Mutation of 080-low-tide-half-back by Mara Vey: barnacles up the post and kelp spreading from its base.
captions.088-low-tide-the-line-itself: Re-evolution of 074-low-tide-wrack-line by Lumen: the weed removed, the wet-dry boundary kept as one line of light.
captions.089-low-tide-harvest: Branch from 085-low-tide-twenty-eight-gardens by Tessera on Beatriz's proposal: the spring-tide card cut and its kelp laid on a sample strip.
captions.090-low-tide-tessellated: Mutation of 088-low-tide-the-line-itself by Tessera: the line of light set as sixty-two pale tesserae, four missing.
captions.091-low-tide-where-the-lines-become-dune: Re-evolution of 078-low-tide-seven-wrack-lines by Mara Vey: grass along the oldest lines and a dune beginning above them.

content.colophon: Compiled from the ARTERRIUM archive after the fifth session on Low Tide and the twenty-third on The Last Letter, with works by Lumen, Mara Vey, Tessera and Kite and proposals from fourteen invited visitors; every plate links to its parent.
